hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Hands clear of handwheels, elevators, and tongs.
Monitors at the tree and flowline; escape sets staged.
No ignition sources at the tree; grounding on the flowline.

name: Upper completion and production tree
function: The permanent equipment that turns the fractured wellbore into a producing well: the tubing string with its packer, safety valve, and accessories hung in the tubing head, and the production tree on top that controls flow to the flowline.

tabs.overview: Once the frac stack comes off, the well is completed for production. Tubing is run with a production packer (or landed open-ended for early flowback on many shale wells), a subsurface safety valve where required, landing nipples, and a seal assembly, and is hung in the tubing head on a tubing hanger. The production tree is bolted onto the tubing head adapter: lower and upper master valves, a flow cross, a production wing with a choke to the flowline, a kill wing, a swab valve, and a cap with a gauge. Artificial lift, when needed, is installed later through the same tree.
tabs.engineering: Tree rating and bore follow API 6A (a 3-1/16 in. 10K tree is common on shale wells); tubing per API 5CT; the safety valve per API 14A where the regulator or operator requires it; packers per API 11D1.
tabs.connections: Tubing hanger in the tubing head (WH); flowline from the wing to the facility; control line to the safety valve; casing annulus outlets on the tubing head.
tabs.safety: The tree is the permanent pressure boundary; valve stems and handwheels are the pinch points; H2S and flammable gas at the tree and flowline.
tabs.specs: Tree 3-1/16 in. 10K typical; tubing 2-7/8 in. typical on shale wells; packer and SSSV ratings per the well.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
tabs.operations: Installed after the drillout and initial flowback, or before flowback where the tubing is needed to lift the well.
tabs.failure_modes: Tree valve seat leaks, choke erosion, tubing leaks, packer seal failure, safety valve failing to close or to hold.
